messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-03-25] handover/2026-03-25-billing-api: The billing API has a new home: team Dune. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-event-bus: Boreal handed the bus to the Dune team today; Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-04-04] handover/2025-04-04-scheduler: The Ember team handed scheduler to Dune today; Oskar Lind wrote up the handover doc for Farah.
- [2026-01-29] handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the feature flag service moves from Cinder to team Dune. Yuki walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2026-01-20] handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer: From today the pager for the resizer rings team Dune, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-12-10] handover/2025-12-10-ledger: Atlas handed the ledger to the Boreal team today; Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2026-04-21] handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags: The feature flag service has a new home: the Atlas team. The Dune team kept it until today.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-03-24] standup/atlas/2025-03-24: The billing API can be released on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-01-12] standup/dune/2026-01-12: The scheduler remains a the Dune team service.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08-2: Heads-up from team Dune: the bus' request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-04-06] handover/2026-04-06-notifier: Handover: as of today the notifier moves from the Cinder team to team Boreal. Yuki walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2025-03-31] standup/dune/2025-03-31: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer: Handover: as of today image-resizer moves from Dune to Cinder. Farah Haddad walked Yuki through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.

Question: Which note recorded the handover of billing-api to Dune, and on what date?
